name: Na izlome dnja
source:
A little girl wanders relentlessly through other people's nightmares. Each one more horrible than the last. Each new one stabs the fragile child's heart with sharp needles.

But there is no turning back. Again and again, she must keep going.

Thanks to the brave Aminta, the nightmares are dispelled and the tormented souls finally find peace.

Yet the little girl is the only one who cannot find her peace....

[Translated from [url=https://onecellteam.itch.io/izlom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个小女孩无情地在别人的噩梦中徘徊。每一个都比上一个更可怕。每一件新的事情都像锋利的针刺在脆弱的孩子的心脏上。

但没有回头路。一次又一次，她必须继续前进。

感谢勇敢的阿明塔，噩梦被驱散，饱受折磨的灵魂终于找到了平静。

然而小女孩是唯一一个无法找到内心平静的人……

[译自[url=https://onecellteam.itch.io/izlom]itch.io[/url]]
